decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 18th January 2016 when the building shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before this date.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans N712/1B/01, N712/1B/02, N712/1B/03, N712/1B/04, N712/1B/05, and Design and Access statement received 3rd August 2010, e-mail and drawings N1007/1B/01 Revision A and N1007/1B/02 Revision A received 27th September 2010 and e-mail with further information received 13th December 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, before the development is commenced, of a scheme to insulate the building against the transmission of airborne and impact sound. The details shall be carried out as approved.
description: Erection of a single storey detached mobile classroom building to house a Speech and Language Centre to the south of the main school building.
